body: [{"streamId":"01a1cfe6-1188-74e9-a49e-88dfe8516528","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1cfe6-1188-74e9-a49e-88dfe8516528\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Another node\\u0027s foreign-session ceiling expiry never replaces a challenge or refinement outcome that the dispatching node recorded, and a node whose replication is behind does not record such an expiry on the first sweep that finds the dispatch overdue.\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022When a draft\\u0027s stream holds a challenge verdict for session S recorded by the node that dispatched S and also another node\\u0027s DispatchExpired failure for S, in either order, the verdict stays the draft\\u0027s latest challenge outcome in both TaskAggregate and TaskDetails: \\u0060h9k task show\\u0060 prints no failed challenge line for S, the publish gate reads the verdict, and a plan waiting on that challenge absorbs the verdict rather than the failure. A DB-free test applies dispatched S, the verdict, a revision, then the expiry (and separately dispatched S, the expiry, then the verdict) to both the aggregate and the projection, and the first ordering fails without the change.\u0022,\u0022The same holds for a refinement session R: when the dispatching node recorded an outcome for R and another node\\u0027s DispatchExpired for R is also on the stream, in either order, the dispatching node\\u0027s outcome is the latest refinement outcome, and the expiry leaves RevisedSinceLastDraftSession and RevisedWhileRefinementRan as the dispatching node\\u0027s outcome left them. A DB-free test covers both orderings on the aggregate and the projection.\u0022,\u0022A challenge outcome recorded for a session other than the running one, arriving while a later challenge session is running, changes neither the running session\\u0027s standing (its session id, node, dispatch time, model and effort) nor the latest challenge outcome, which is the guard refinement outcomes already have. A DB-free test fails without the change.\u0022,\u0022Neither DraftChallengeEngine nor PlanEngine ends another node\\u0027s dispatch on the first sweep that finds it past the foreign-session ceiling. It ends one only if the dispatch is still standing when a later sweep runs at least a settle period after the first, and the settle period is longer than the message sweep\\u0027s idle poll ceiling, so at least one replication read of the dispatching node\\u0027s outbox happens in between. An integration test per engine seeds an overdue foreign dispatch, runs a sweep that records nothing, appends the dispatching node\\u0027s outcome, runs a second sweep past the settle period, and finds no DispatchExpired on the stream. Without the change, the first sweep records one.\u0022,\u0022A dispatch from a node that never records an outcome is still ended once it has stood past the ceiling and stayed standing through the settle period. The existing tests for this, in DraftChallengeEngineTests and PlanEngineTests, still pass, changed only to account for the settle period.\u0022,\u0022docs/cli.md, where it says a dispatch another node made is ended past the foreign-session ceiling, also says the dispatch is ended only after the settle period and that the dispatching node\\u0027s own outcome wins over an expiry. If the settle period is a new daemon option, the options table in docs/operations.md has a row for it.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## What happened\\n\\nOn 2026-11-12 one node dispatched a plan\\u0027s challenge session on a draft at 11:45:28 UTC, and in the same second the\\nrefinement session of a sibling draft. The challenge recorded a verdict at 11:48 and the refinement recorded Revised at\\n11:50. Both drafts were revised, published, and finished. At 13:10 UTC a second node of the same owner recorded\\nDispatchExpired for both sessions. Those records reached the first node at 13:14, and its feed told the operator to\\nchallenge again. \\u0060h9k task show\\u0060 on the first draft now prints a failed challenge beside the verdict, and on the sibling\\nit prints \\u0022Refinement not applied\\u0022 with the same reason. The first node had received nothing from the second between\\n11:23 and 13:14, and the expiries name sessions dispatched just before that silence began. The likely reading is that the\\nsecond node was suspended or offline from about 11:46, resumed at about 13:10, and swept before its inbox delivered\\noutcomes that had been recorded long before. That is inferred: the second node\\u0027s own store and log were not read.\\n\\nThe revision after the verdict is not the cause. Revisions only set RevisedWhileChallengeRan when a session is running\\n(\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Tasks/TaskAggregate.cs\\u0060, the \\u0060RevisedWhileChallengeRan |=\\u0060 line in the TaskRevised apply).\\nThe sweep reads TaskDetails.RunningChallengeSessionId, which a recorded outcome clears, so the expiring node had the\\ndispatch and not the outcome. The sweep can never skip a verdict it has not yet received, so the fix has two halves.\\n\\n## Where the code is (at a8cfd74dd)\\n\\n- The sweeps: \\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Challenge/DraftChallengeEngine.cs\\u0060 \\u0060RecoverAsync\\u0060 (the \\u0060else if\\u0060 foreign branch) and\\n  \\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Plan/PlanEngine.cs\\u0060 \\u0060RecoverAsync\\u0060 (the same branch for refinement). Both compare\\n  \\u0060DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - dispatchedAt\\u0060 against \\u0060_options.ForeignPublicationCeiling\\u0060. The expiry is recorded under the\\n  dispatching node\\u0027s id, so a receiver can tell an expiry only by its \\u0060Failure\\u0060 being \\u0060DispatchExpired\\u0060.\\n- The appliers: \\u0060TaskAggregate.Apply(DraftChallengeRecorded)\\u0060 and \\u0060Apply(DraftRefinementRecorded)\\u0060, and their\\n  counterparts in \\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Tasks/Projections/TaskDetails.cs\\u0060. The refinement appliers already ignore\\n  an outcome for a session other than the running one, but not one that arrives after its own session\\u0027s outcome. The\\n  challenge appliers have neither guard.\\n- What reads the latest outcome: \\u0060ChallengeGate.Shortfall\\u0060, \\u0060PlanEngine\\u0060 (the loop that absorbs a challenge outcome\\n  whose \\u0060RecordedAt\\u0060 is at or after the plan\\u0027s request), and \\u0060TaskShowCommand\\u0060 (the challenge and refinement blocks).\\n- The message sweep\\u0027s idle cadence is \\u0060MessageIdlePollMinSeconds\\u0060 and \\u0060MessageIdlePollMaxSeconds\\u0060 in\\n  \\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/DaemonOptions.cs\\u0060. The replication read is \\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Messaging/MessageSweepEngine.cs\\u0060.\\n\\n## The smallest shape\\n\\nOn the applier side, take one rule for both outcome types. An outcome for a session that is running applies, as today.\\nAn outcome for a session other than a running one is ignored. With nothing running, a DispatchExpired outcome for a\\nsession that already has an outcome is ignored, and a dispatching node\\u0027s outcome for a session whose latest outcome is\\nthat session\\u0027s own expiry replaces it. Any other outcome for a session that already has one is ignored. Outcomes with no\\nsession id (refused before a spawn) apply as today. That rule makes the end state the same whichever order the two\\nrecords arrive in, which matters because the expiring node itself receives the verdict after its own expiry.\\n\\nOn the sweep side, the smallest change is in-memory. Each engine remembers when it first saw each foreign session\\noverdue, ends the session only on a sweep at least the settle period later, and forgets sessions that are no longer\\nrunning. A restart starts the count over, which is the safe direction. One gap is accepted: a node suspended again\\nduring the settle period can expire on waking. The applier rule still corrects what every node shows, but the feed would\\ncarry the line. Making the sweep wait for an actual replication read of the dispatching node is the stronger fence, but\\nthat would couple the engines to the message sweep and cost more than the incident justifies.\\n\\nOut of scope: the publication session\\u0027s own foreign ceiling (the same option, a different engine), and changing the feed\\nso it describes events against stream state. Documents already projected with the stale failure keep it until\\nsomething rebuilds them; a rebuild is not required here.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-12T13:22:37.741899\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022HumanGate\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RefinementSessionId\u0022:\u002201a1cfe6-32c1-7104-a5f4-b085e5a47d81\u0022,\u0022FeedbackStep\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"076eda5d-3530-4841-b95b-6229708c4daa","originSequence":183522,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-11-12T13:22:37.755611+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a1cfe6-1188-74e9-a49e-88dfe8516528","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.PublicationTokensRecorded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1cfe6-1188-74e9-a49e-88dfe8516528\u0022,\u0022InputTokens\u0022:76,\u0022OutputTokens\u0022:31141,\u0022CostUsd\u0022:1.8853488,\u0022RecordedAt\u0022:\u00222026-11-12T13:22:38.977683\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022CacheReadInputTokens\u0022:2522404,\u0022CacheCreationInputTokens\u0022:94718,\u0022Model\u0022:\u0022claud
